creator: Alexander Terp
description:
One command runs everything, decided before there are two languages to run. If the Swift shell lands 'swift test' and a core later lands its own runner, nothing forces anyone to notice the suite has quietly split in two - the green-suite desideratum erodes without a decision ever being made.

'./dev' at the repo root, written in Rad, using clustered short bool flags so common combinations stay one token: './dev -t' tests, './dev -tl' tests and lints, and so on. It delegates to each subproject's native tooling rather than reimplementing it.

CI invokes the same script and nothing else, so the command a contributor runs and the command that gates a merge cannot drift apart.

Lands with the first code commit - there is nothing to run before that.

Consequence to handle: this puts Rad (https://github.com/amterp/rad) on the path for anyone who wants to run the suite. Fail with a clear install pointer when it is missing, and install it explicitly in CI.
title: dev: one Rad script as the door to build, test, and lint
